title: BrandVoice
description: A snapshot of what a session has been approving: how much, how well it scored, and which channels and objectives it kept coming back to. Counted once and written down, so the figures a person saw on a day can be shown again on another day without recounting them.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

session.description: The session this was counted over, as the system that owns the session names it. Optional: scoping a profile to a working session is how Creative Flow holds it, not part of what it is, and a system without sessions must be able to carry the same shape.

approvedCount.description: How many pieces had been approved when the snapshot was taken.

avgOverallScore.description: The mean of the latest score of each scored generation. Absent when nothing had been scored yet, which is not the same as zero.

topChannels.description: The channels that came up most, most frequent first. A list, whatever a given store serialises it into.

topObjectives.description: The objectives that came up most, most frequent first.

createdAt.description: When the snapshot was taken. It is what makes the figures readable later: they are true of that moment and of no other.
